topic: Diamond rain on Neptune and Uranus
script: Deep inside Neptune and Uranus, it may rain diamonds. These planets hold carbon and hydrogen under crushing pressure and heat. Scientists think that pressure can squeeze carbon into diamonds that sink toward the core. In 2017, researchers used powerful lasers to make tiny diamonds from similar materials in a lab. So some of the biggest diamonds in the solar system may be hidden where no one can ever reach them. Follow WonderBytes for more facts that sound fake but are true.
